questions.title: Cast Iron Sewer Pipe Cost Estimator
questions.subtitle: Use a few project details to estimate a Dallas sewer repair or replacement range.
questions.html: This test estimator uses Mother's Dallas sewer replacement cost guide as its pricing baseline. It is not a camera inspection or final quote.

questions.title: How many feet of sewer line are involved?
questions.subtitle: A rough linear-foot estimate is enough for this test.
questions.label: Pipe length

questions.title: Which repair or replacement method sounds closest?
questions.subtitle: Pick the best match. A plumber would confirm this with a camera inspection.

options.label: Partial excavation replacement
options.description: Usually for a damaged section up to about 50 feet.

options.label: Full sewer line replacement
options.description: Usually for long runs, broad deterioration, collapse, or failed cast iron/clay.

options.label: Sewer reroute
options.description: A new route around the slab, hardscaping, or recurring problem area.

options.label: CIPP sewer lining
options.description: Trenchless liner. Not always available for collapsed or badly deformed cast iron.

options.label: Pipe bursting
options.description: Trenchless replacement that can fit some corroded cast iron or smaller collapsed sections.

options.label: I'm not sure yet
options.description: Use the broad Dallas sewer replacement range until a camera inspection narrows it.

questions.title: How hard is the pipe to access?
questions.subtitle: Excavation, hardscaping, depth, and slab proximity can materially change labor.

options.label: Clear yard access
options.description: No major hardscaping, slab, pool, or mature landscaping in the way.

options.label: Mature landscaping or deeper pipe
options.description: More careful digging or remediation may be needed.

options.label: Patio, driveway, pool, or deck nearby
options.description: Hardscaping increases labor, planning, and restoration time.

options.label: Near or under the slab foundation
options.description: Precision tunneling or rerouting may be needed.

options.label: I'm not sure
options.description: Use a moderate access allowance until the line is inspected.

questions.title: What permit situation sounds closest?
questions.subtitle: Dallas sewer work commonly requires permits and inspection fees.

options.label: Standard residential sewer permit
options.description: Typical residential permit and inspection allowance.

options.label: Larger project permit
options.description: Bigger jobs tend to land toward the higher end of Dallas permit costs.

options.label: Excavation or right-of-way permit may apply
options.description: Use this when street, alley, or extended excavation permitting may be involved.

options.label: I'm not sure
options.description: Use a broad Dallas permit allowance.
